stories.title: ‘Everybody’s connected’: Oakesdale remembers Deputy Parker Perry
stories.summary: The Oakesdale community mourns Deputy Parker Perry. KREM 2's Emily Million Fox talked to Superintendent Dingman, who remembers Perry for his dedication.

stories.title: Traffic Impact Alert: Northbound US-395 near Ritzville reopens following semi-truck crash
stories.summary: A semi-truck crash blocked both northbound lanes of US-395 just two miles south of Ritzville on Sunday morning.

stories.title: Washington State Patrol investigating deadly hit-and-run crash in Okanogan County
stories.summary: The roadway is closed on SR-215 near Milepost 2 on Nolan Road because of a deadly car vs. pedestrian crash in Okanogan County Sunday morning.

stories.title: Community candlelight vigil for Spokane County Deputies Mason Acheson, Parker Perry set for Nov. 17
stories.summary: The vigil, which starts at 7 p.m., will be at the Law Enforcement Memorial Monument, located at 1100 West Mallon Avenue.

stories.title: Local sports teams dealing with fall out from nationwide FAA ground stop
stories.summary: The EWU football game at Utah Tech will now kick off at 6 p.m. while the Idaho football game against No. 23 UC Davis will kick off at 5 p.m. at the Kibbie Dome.

stories.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop after hours of delays
stories.summary: The FAA said the stop was due to communication issues impacting air traffic control centers and "extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety.”

stories.title: 31st annual Fall Folk Festival returns to Spokane Community College
stories.summary: The free event is scheduled for Nov. 14 from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m. and Nov. 15 from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.

stories.title: Doors opening: The Currents will provide homeownership for more local workers
stories.summary: About 104 homes are planned for construction at Atlas Waterfront.

stories.title: Trial continues for man accused of killing mother
stories.summary: Susan Stratton's son, Neil Stratton, 53, is on trial for allegedly beating her in September 2025 and inflicting the injuries that led to her death three weeks later.

stories.title: Holocaust survivor Eva Schneider coming to Spokane to share her story
stories.summary: “I spent a lifetime not talking about it, and then somebody asked me to tell my story, and I haven't stopped since,” 93-year-old Eva Schneider said.

stories.title: Spokane County Sheriff’s Office investigating body found in Bear Lake
stories.summary: SCSO says it is unknown if the body is that of a paddleboarder who was reported missing on July 24 and presumed drowned.

stories.title: Spokane Valley man dead after fiery car vs. semi-truck crash on Highway 53 north of Post Falls
stories.summary: Idaho State Police say the car crashed head-on into a semi-truck and both vehicles caught fire. The driver of the car died on the scene.
